headlines.title: Morgan Stanley Expects Elia Group to Raise FY26 Net Income Guidance
headlines.line: Morgan Stanley analysts have projected that Elia Group is likely to increase its net income guidance for the 2026 fiscal year.

headlines.title: Meta Abandons 2030 Net-Zero Emissions Goal
headlines.line: Meta has officially moved away from its commitment to reach net-zero emissions by 2030, citing the energy-intensive infrastructure requirements of its AI expansion.

headlines.title: JPMorgan Chase Increases Stake in Intertek Group PLC
headlines.line: JPMorgan Chase & Co. reported an increase in its voting rights stake in Intertek Group PLC to 7.779964% as of November 19, 2026.

headlines.title: Morgan Stanley Upgrades Millicom International Cellular to Overweight
headlines.line: Morgan Stanley has upgraded Millicom International Cellular to Overweight from Equalweight, setting a price target of $100.

headlines.title: Fairness Hearing Held for Hormel Turkey Price-Fixing Settlement
headlines.line: A fairness hearing was scheduled for November 24, 2026, regarding the $37.5 million settlement involving Hormel Foods and its Jennie-O Turkey Store unit in the turkey antitrust litigation.

headlines.title: Hormel Foods Increases Quarterly Dividend
headlines.line: Hormel Foods Corporation announced a 1% increase to its quarterly dividend, raising it to $0.295 per share.

headlines.title: StoneX Completes First Legally Binding Digital Gold Transactions
headlines.line: StoneX, alongside HSBC and JPMorgan Chase, has completed the first live, legally binding wholesale-market transactions using Pooled Gold Interests (PGIs).

headlines.title: J.P. Morgan Asset Management Announces November 2026 ETF Distributions
headlines.line: J.P. Morgan Asset Management has declared the final cash distributions for its suite of ETFs listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange for November 2026.

headlines.title: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Meta Platforms
headlines.line: Morgan Stanley and JPMorgan have adjusted their price targets for Meta Platforms, reflecting updated market expectations.

headlines.title: Meta Launches Muse AI in the UK

headlines.title: TrendForce Reports Growing Demand for AMD Helios AI Server Systems
headlines.line: Market research firm TrendForce reports increasing demand from cloud service providers for AMD's Helios AI server systems, while noting potential deployment and delivery challenges.

headlines.title: Clapp Finance Launches Crypto Card on Visa Network
headlines.line: Clapp Finance has introduced a new crypto-linked card that allows users to spend stablecoins or borrow against crypto collateral using the Visa payment network.

headlines.title: Odola Fintech Platform to Offer Visa Debit Card for Migrant Workers
headlines.line: WorldRemit founder Ismail Ahmed is launching a new fintech platform called Odola, which will provide migrant workers with a Visa debit card for salary deposits and international remittances.

headlines.title: Boeing Secures Order for 50 737-8 Aircraft from China Southern Airlines Unit
headlines.line: Boeing has received an order for 50 737-8 jets from a unit of China Southern Airlines.

headlines.title: The Cigna Group Foundation Expands Support for Youth Mental Health and Veterans
headlines.line: The Cigna Group Foundation has announced an extension of its national partnership with the Boys and Girls Clubs of America, focusing on adolescent mental health and veteran support.

summary:
US equities rallied sharply in the 2026-11-23 session. The Nasdaq 100 (QQQ) rose 7.00%, the S&P 500 (SPY) gained 4.71%, and the Dow (DIA) added 3.06%. Technology led, with XLK up 8.97%. Energy lagged: XLE fell 1.06% on the day and 6.00% over five days, and oil (USO) dropped 4.49%. Gold (GLD) rose 3.14%, and the VIX short-term futures proxy (VIXY) fell 12.99%. Economic data were mixed. The Chicago Fed National Activity Index printed -0.06 against a 0.20 consensus, and the S&P Global Composite PMI came in at 54.6 against 55.6 expected.

Pre-market, as of about 13:17 UTC, SPY was down 1.46%, QQQ down 2.43%, and XLK down 3.44%. Individual pre-market moves rest on thin volume and may not reflect real prices; SHOE, for instance, is down 22.8% on about 40% of an average day's volume. Today's calendar includes ADP employment, Consumer Confidence (consensus 92.4), house price indices, and a 5-year note auction.
